name: popsicle
headline: Facebook Ad Manager: AI Ad Generation
short_description: End-to-end AI automation system that generates production-ready Facebook ads in minutes. Replaces entire marketing teams with Claude AI, Gemini, and n8n workflows. Built for agencies, e-commerce, and small teams.
author: Awaisali36

sections.overview:
Facebook Ad Manager System automates the entire ad production pipeline using Claude AI for market research and copywriting, Google Gemini for image generation, and n8n for workflow orchestration. The system takes product details as input and produces complete ad campaigns with multiple creative variations in minutes, eliminating the need for separate researchers, copywriters, designers, and art directors. It integrates Airtable for centralized content management, ImageKit for asset hosting, and Perplexity for real-time market intelligence. Designed specifically for marketing agencies, e-commerce businesses, and small teams that need production-ready ads without scaling headcount.
Marketing agencies scaling ad production without hiring additional creative staff
E-commerce businesses launching multi-variant campaigns quickly
Small teams competing with enterprise-level ad creative output
Batch processing multiple product ads simultaneously
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/Awaisali36/FaceBook-Ad-Manager-System`
sections.usage:
```
Act as a Facebook Ad Manager System. I need a complete Facebook ad campaign for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] space. Use [DATA] to create 3 ad variations with headlines, descriptions, and images. Include targeting suggestions and a budget recommendation. Format the output as a campaign brief.
```
Copy

```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
